title: Publication Package Project Request
description: Input to the `Publication Package Project` reusable workflow (and its dev test webhook). Mirrors the Step 6-10 orchestrator request shape. See docs/architecture/publication-package-pipeline.md#input.

target_publication_sections.description: Sections to target for a revision: "thumbnail:<variant_number>", "titles", "description", "chapters", "tags", "hashtags", "pinned_comment", "community_post", "promotional_copy", or "all". Empty/omitted means a fresh full rebuild.
